name: AvtoPromStal
description: Forging the future of Russian automotive engineering.
story: AvtoPromStal is a leading Russian steel manufacturer specializing in high-performance alloys for the automotive industry. With a long history of supplying materials to Russian motorsport teams, they now seek to expand their brand visibility on the international stage. They believe that a partnership with a successful racing team will demonstrate the quality and reliability of their products to a global audience.
